metadata.case_name: HUANG XIAO CHUN v. 蔡榮全

plaintiff.occupation_before: Decoration worker (in Hong Kong); prior to trip: electrician and formerly management staff in a shoe factory (Mainland)

injuries.description: ruptured right eyeball / right eye visual loss (enucleation of right eye)
source: CT scan revealed fractured right maxillary sinus and ruptured right eyeball.
Eventually on 20 November 2007, Caritas Medical Centre removed his right eyeball and he was set to receive an orbital implant insertion.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration or rupture with prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

source: CT scan revealed fractured right maxillary sinus and ruptured right eyeball.

injuries.description: facial lacerations resulting in linear scar and disfigurement (right forehead, eyelids, eyeball area, nose and upper lip)
injuries.body_part: face (right forehead, eyelids, nose, upper lip)
source: The rotating blade hit his face, resulting in facial laceration across his right forehead, eyelids, eyeball, nose and lips.

Dr Ho also noticed a linear scar extending from the right upper part of face to left lower part of face. The same transected the plaintiff’s forehead, the upper and lower eyelids, nose and extended to upper lip.

injuries.description: mild head injury / post-concussional syndrome (including headache, dizziness and deterioration in memory)
source: Dr Yu said plaintiff had sustained a mild head injury with negligible post traumatic amnesia.

Certificate of Review of Assessment (Form 9) dated 4 May 2010 assessed the plaintiff as suffering from multiple injuries resulting in right eye visual loss, right face scar, nose disfigurement, post-concussional syndrome (including headache, dizziness and deterioration in memory).
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with incomplete loss of consciousness with amnesia

injuries.description: adhesion between the lower eyelid and the mucous membrane of the surface of the socket; shallow empty socket preventing fitting of false eye
source: The right eyeball was then already removed and the empty socket was shallow. The mucous membrane of the socket was mildly congested and there was adhesion between the lower eyelid and the mucous membrane of the surface of the socket. Dr Ho said this was the reason why he said the false eye could not fit.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of eye or orbit

manifestations.description: noticeable linear scar on face (transecting forehead, eyelids, nose, upper lip)
adhesion between lower eyelid and socket mucous membrane preventing fitting of false eye

treatments_received: sent to Princess Margaret Hospital; CT scan performed
urgent operation to suture the eyelids, facial lacerations, and repair of right eyeball
analgesic and anti-dizziness drugs on a need to basis
removal of right eyeball (enucleation) on 20 November 2007
reconstructions of right eye socket (27 March 2008)
making and insertion of artificial right eye (September 2010, Shanghai)
removal and reinsertion of artificial eye (June 2011, 泉州醫院)
follow-up consultations and treatments for inflammation in right eye socket
treatments_future: at least one more operation to revise the right socket so that he can fit in the artificial eye (Dr Ho opinion)

losses.description: Total loss of right eye / right eye visual loss and resulting loss of vision-related function
Noticeable linear scar on face and nose disfigurement affecting external appearance

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Difficulty in playing ball games due to impaired depth and distance perception
Fewer job opportunities and disadvantage in labour market because of having one eye and poor external appearance
Difficulty in driving due to impaired distance and depth perception

comparable_cases.injury_description: total loss of vision of 1 eye together with other injuries
injury to good eye leading to virtual inability to see; multiple operations; hospitalized about 5 weeks
